Q4842397.label: 2002 Bahamian general election
Q4842397.summary: General elections were held in the Bahamas on 2 May 2002. The opposition Progressive Liberal Party (PLP) won 29 of the 40 seats in the House of Assembly to defeat the governing Free National Movement (FNM). Voter turnout was 90%.

Q5255581.label: Democratic Change
Q5255581.summary: Democratic Change is a centre-right political party in Panama.

Q2344349.label: 2002 Dutch general election
Q2344349.desc: election of the members of the House of Representatives
Q2344349.summary: General elections were held in the Netherlands on 15 May 2002. The elections were amongst the most dramatic in Dutch history, not just in terms of the electoral results, as they were completely overshadowed by the assassination of leader Pim Fortuyn only nine days before election day.

Q2660765.label: 2007 Dutch Senate election
Q2660765.summary: Elections to the Dutch Senate were held on 29 May 2007, following the provincial elections on 7 March 2007. The 564 members of the twelve States-Provincial elected the 75 Senate members. The new Senate was installed on 12 June 2007.

Q1607581.label: 1997 Slovenian presidential election
Q1607581.summary: Presidential elections were held in Slovenia on 23 November 1997. The result was a victory for incumbent Milan Kučan, who won 55.54% of the vote. Voter turnout was 68.65%.

Q2737053.label: Slovenian European Union and NATO membership referendum
Q2737053.wiki: 2003 Slovenian European Union and NATO membership referendum
Q2737053.summary: A referendum on membership of the European Union and NATO was held in Slovenia on 23 March 2003.

Q140480413.label: Vasile Tofan
Q140480413.desc: Moldovan investor and businessman (born 1982), Prime Minister of Moldova
Q140480413.summary: Vasile Tofan is a Moldovan investor and businessman. He has served as Prime Minister of Moldova since 22 July 2026, having been nominated by president Maia Sandu on 11 July.

Q43544477.label: 2017 Sinai mosque attack
Q43544477.desc: terrorist bombing in a Sinai mosque, Egypt
Q43544477.summary: At 1:50 PM EET on 24 November 2017, the al-Rawda mosque was attacked by roughly 40 gunmen during Friday prayers. The mosque is located in the village of Al-Rawda east of the town of Bir al-Abed in Egypt's North Sinai Governorate. It is one of the main mosques associated with the Jaririya Sufi order, one of the largest Sufi orders in North Sinai.

Q28573.label: Inca Empire
Q28573.summary: The Inca Empire, officially known as the Realm of the Four Parts, was the largest empire in pre-Columbian America. The administrative, political, and military center of the empire was in the city of Cusco. The Inca civilisation rose from the Peruvian highlands sometime in the early 13th century. The Portuguese explorer Aleixo Garcia was the first European to reach the Inca Empire in 1524. Later, in 1532, the Spanish began the conquest of the Inca Empire, and by 1572 the last Inca state was fully conquered.

Q152989.label: Western Front
Q152989.desc: theatre of WWI in France and Belgium
Q152989.summary: The Western Front was one of the main theatres of war during World War I. Following the outbreak of war in August 1914, the German Army opened the Western Front by invading Luxembourg and Belgium, then gaining military control of important industrial regions in France. The German advance was halted with the Battle of the Marne. Following the Race to the Sea, both sides dug in along a meandering line of fortified trenches, stretching from the North Sea to the Swiss frontier with France, the position of which changed little except during early 1917 and again in 1918.

Q785309.label: Goulash Communism
Q785309.desc: form of communism in the Hungarian People's Republic from the 1960s until the Central European collapse of communism in 1989
Q785309.summary: Goulash Communism, also known as refrigerator communism, Kádárism or the Hungarian Thaw, is the variety of state socialism in the Hungarian People's Republic following the Hungarian Revolution of 1956. During János Kádár's period of leadership, the Hungarian People's Republic implemented policies with the goal to create a high standard of living for the people of Hungary coupled with economic reforms.
